slides.headline: 6 THINGS YOUR BUSINESS PAYS FOR DEEPSEEK NOW DOES FREE
slides.image_prompt: DeepSeek logo glowing electric blue, single dollar symbol accent, dark near-black background, centered minimalist composition.

slides.headline: 1) FIND EVERY MISSED PAYMENT IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: Doing this manually for one month of invoices takes 2 to 3 hours out of your week. This takes 60 seconds.
slides.image_prompt: Hands sorting printed invoices on a desk, the top page circled in red pen around a bold dollar-sign symbol, a laptop screen showing a red exclamation triangle beside it. Warm desk lamp. Accent: electric blue against dark wood. Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain.

slides.headline: 2) READ YOUR COMPETITOR'S PRICES IN ONE SCREENSHOT
slides.body: DeepSeek lists every plan, price, and feature, and what they are burying in the fine print. What used to take a 2-hour manual scan takes one prompt.

slides.headline: 3) PASTE A CONTRACT CLAUSE. KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING.
slides.body: DeepSeek translates it into plain English and flags what you should push back on. A business lawyer charges $350 to $500 an hour for this same read.

slides.headline: 4) YOUR BUSINESS HEALTH. 60 SECONDS.
slides.body: Send your dashboard. Get a plain English diagnosis in 60 seconds.

slides.headline: 5) AUDIT YOUR PRODUCT PHOTOS BEFORE YOU POST THEM
slides.body: DeepSeek tells you what a buyer notices in the first 3 seconds: wrong lighting, bad framing, cluttered background. Catching this before posting saves you from listings that get views but no sales.
slides.image_prompt: Small product bottle on a white tabletop, two hands raising a phone overhead to photograph it, a second phone screen in the foreground showing three checkmark bullet symbols. Bright window daylight. Accent: orange against white. Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain.

slides.headline: 6) TURN A WHITEBOARD PHOTO INTO A CLEAN ACTION LIST
slides.body: DeepSeek reads your handwriting and breaks everything into three buckets: decisions made, open questions, and next steps. No more lost action items by the time you get back to your desk.

caption:
Swipe for 6 things DeepSeek's new visual AI does from a screenshot tonight 📸 invoices, contracts, competitor pages, dashboards, photos, and whiteboards.

1 is the fastest way to find overdue payments hiding in your invoice stack, 2 is how to get a full competitor breakdown from one screenshot of their pricing page, 3 is getting any contract clause translated into plain English before you sign, 4 is sending your sales dashboard to DeepSeek and getting a plain English diagnosis in under a minute, 5 is auditing your product photos for everything a buyer notices in the first 3 seconds, 6 is turning any whiteboard photo into a clean action list with owners and next steps.

DeepSeek launched a visual AI today that reads any image you send it. Every document, photo, and screen in your business is now readable in under a minute. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this does for yours.

Sources: DeepSeek, X (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp official launch, Aug 21 2026)
